figures.caption: Figure 1: Dynamic Betti Curves — Predicted Dream vs. Dreamless EEG (Schematic). SCHEMATIC ONLY — no DREAM data were analysed to produce this figure. Empirical Betti curves from DREAM EDF data will be presented in the follow-up.

Table 1: Validation scheme mapping (revised). The primary hypothesis-testing statistic is now macro-averaged across per-dataset AUCs (never a raw pooled/concatenated-prediction AUC, which risks Simpson’s-paradox artefacts), and the primary Bonferroni family spans all hypothesis-metric combinations (m = 15) rather than metrics alone (m = 5) or the original invalid per-dataset-vsaggregate comparison (m = 30).

Table 2: Candidate Betti transition patterns (exploratory, pre-validation). Presented at a deliberately coarse, qualitative level; exact numerical criteria are not pre-specified here and will be defined only once the empirical validation in Section 4.6 has been run. This is not a validated classification scheme.

Figure 2: Candidate Betti Transition Patterns (Schematic, non-quantitative). All patterns are theoretically motivated, exploratory priors requiring empirical validation (Section 4.6); phenomenological associations are conjectured, not established, and should not be read as a finished atlas.
Figure 3: Projected AUC ranges vs. published baselines (illustrative; see caption in figure and Section 5.4 text for non-binding status).
